NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author edited the PR description: it now says "Part of #16189", explains how the fixture was made, and has a screenshot. There was no new push.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | The description now says "Part of #16189" instead of closing the issue. |
| ✅  | A screenshot of the notification was added to the description. |
| ❌  | The fixture was built by hand from Atlassian's API spec, not captured from a real Jira instance, which the fixture guidelines require. |
| ℹ️  | Maintainers have already rejected constructed fixtures on the related Jira PR #39998. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to replace the fixture with a payload captured from a real Jira instance.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for updating the description and adding the screenshot! The remaining problem is the fixture: it needs to be a payload captured from a real Jira instance (for example with webhook.site), not one built by hand from the API spec. Please capture a real `attachment_created` payload, update the fixture and test, and regenerate the screenshot, following the [fixture guidelines](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/webhooks/incoming-webhooks-walkthrough.html#fixture-guidelines).
```
